column1: # Callers of the setting value accessor at 0x0043d4d0 in magicitem.cpp
# The accessor's 32-bit form, which returned the address 4 bytes into the
# setting. No object defines it; a call whose argument is a setting of the
# shared class goes to the form that takes the shared Setting:
# batch, unit, function, the accessor. A sample: the readers of the processor
# count setting g_011c3ea4 in three units, and one caller for each other
# argument form (a cast of a global, a table of globals, a choice between two
# globals, a reinterpret_cast form, a global of the second generated family).
# batch, unit, function, the accessor: every function of main.cpp that calls
# the accessor (VEGAS-115), WinMain's three writes of the processor count
# among them. 0x0086f6a0 is not listed: it keeps one call on the 32-bit form,
# on g_011d10d4, a name that no object defines.
